key_highlights: ASX slides as oil nears US$100/bbl amid Iran-US conflict; rate hike bets intensify, big four banks fall
RBA perceived as choosing recession path; business conditions weakest since pandemic
Iron ore in structural decline – 'drowning, not waving' – pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG
WA gold sector surges: Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway all report major discoveries/financing
Coal workers back strike at WA energy grid; data centre demand at coal sites creates energy transition tension
Home buyer sentiment collapses; NZ house price crash returns – regional housing stress
Santos gas cartel dynamics shift; Chevron extends record run
Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid; Qantas fires workers with $35M payout

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural downtrend; copper and gold counter-cyclical strength. Flagship ups copper in Canada; WA gold discoveries (Auric 102koz, Golden Dragon high-grade hits, Forrestania offtake, Gateway $45M drill-out) signal sector rotation into precious metals.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from iron ore weakness and China impatience with Trump tariffs. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX, WES.AX) and copper (STO.AX, FMG.AX) offer relative strength. Chinese-owned miner licence issues add regulatory risk.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall as rising oil fuels rate hike expectations, compressing NIMs and raising credit-risk concerns. RBA perceived as prioritising inflation over growth ('choosing recession').
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX under pressure from rate-hike-driven equity sell-off and deteriorating business conditions. Mortgage stress risk rising with home buyer sentiment collapse.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran-US conflict and Hormuz disruption. Santos gas cartel dynamics shifting. Coal strike at WA grid threatens supply. Data centre demand at coal sites creates policy tension. Chevron extends record run.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, BRL.AX benefit from oil spike but face political headwinds. Coal (WES.AX, STX.AX) faces strike risk and transition pressure. Energy storage pivot (GM/Ford) signals structural shift.

sectors.trend: Business conditions weakest since pandemic. Qantas fires workers ($35M payout). 102-year-old mall retailer closes 25 stores. Housing sentiment collapses. Employers paying premium for 'human' skills amid AI disruption.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX, WES.AX, WBC.AX consumer exposure under pressure. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face retail and housing stress. Labour cost inflation persists.

sectors.trend: AI data centres at coal sites signal energy-intensive demand. ATO vs Big Tech tax fight. AFL-AI deal. Twilio AI push in LatAm. S&P 500 rebalancing (Illumina, Everpure).
sectors.implications: ASX tech names limited; indirect exposure via energy demand. ATO enforcement may pressure offshore earnings of CSL.AX, WES.AX. Data centre build-out supports electricity demand but strains grid.

key_themes: Geopolitical oil shock: Iran-US conflict, Hormuz risk, US$100 oil
RBA recession dilemma: rate hikes vs growth collapse
Iron ore structural decline and China-US trade friction
Energy transition vs data centre demand tension
USD strength (75-day rally) pressuring AUD and commodity exporters

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour oil producers (SOL.AX, WDS.AX) over refiners; monitor Brent/WTI spreads
Reduce rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure; favour dividend-paying defensives; monitor RBA statement

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse / China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and copper

risk_assessment.risk_factor: WA coal strike / energy supply disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AGL.AX, INC.AX, WES.AX power supply; strike could spike electricity prices
Reduce REIT exposure; watch bank NPL data; favour CSL.AX, WES.AX defensives
AUD-sensitive miners face margin compression; consider AUD hedging for exporters

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold miners on discovery super-cycle
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade hits (Auric 102koz, Golden Dragon, Gateway $45M) signal sector-wide upside; gold benefits from geopolitical risk and USD volatility

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long oil & gas producers on US$100 oil
opportunities.rationale: Iran conflict and Hormuz risk sustain elevated oil; Chevron record run validates sector; Santos gas dynamics shifting favourably

opportunities.recommendation: Copper exposure via Flagship and peers
opportunities.rationale: Copper soars on energy transition demand; Flagship ups Canadian stakes; structural supply deficit

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and rate-sensitive equity exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'drowning'; RBA rate-hike bias pressures banks and REITs; business conditions at pandemic lows

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash / short-duration bonds as recession risk rises
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA 'choosing recession'; home buyer sentiment collapse; defensive positioning warranted

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness via commodity-linked equities
defensive_moves.rationale: 75-day USD rally pressures AUD; commodity exporters with USD revenue benefit

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure: oil-driven rate-hike fears, iron ore weakness, and deteriorating business conditions cap upside. Gold and energy names outperform. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and Iran conflict developments. Key support test on ^AXJO.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious: if RBA forces a recession, cyclicals (mining, banks, REITs) face 10–15% drawdown risk. Gold, energy, and healthcare (CSL.AX) offer relative resilience. Iron ore structural decline may be permanent. Data centre energy demand could create a new utility/energy investment theme.
